1.web: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed; and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have made an end of betrayal, you will be betrayed.
1.asv: Woe to thee that destroyest, and thou wast not destroyed; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! When thou hast ceased to destroy, thou shalt be destroyed; and when thou hast made an end of dealing treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.

2.web: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
2.asv: O Jehovah, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou our arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

3.web: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.
3.asv: At the noise of the tumult the peoples are fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations are scattered.

4.web: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.
4.asv: And your spoil shall be gathered as the caterpillar gathereth: as locusts leap shall men leap upon it.

5.web: Yahweh is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
5.asv: Jehovah is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

6.web: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of Yahweh is your treasure.
6.asv: And there shall be stability in thy times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge: the fear of Jehovah is thy treasure.

7.web: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
7.asv: Behold, their valiant ones cry without; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.

8.web: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.
8.asv: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: the enemy hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth not man.

9.web: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.
9.asv: The land mourneth and languisheth; Lebanon is confounded and withereth away; Sharon is like a desert; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their leaves.

10.web: “Now I will arise,” says Yahweh; “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.
10.asv: Now will I arise, saith Jehovah; now will I lift up myself; now will I be exalted.

11.web: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.
11.asv: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath is a fire that shall devour you.

12.web: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.
12.asv: And the peoples shall be as the burnings of lime, as thorns cut down, that are burned in the fire.

13.web: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”
13.asv: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.

14.web: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?
14.asv: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling hath seized the godless ones: Who among us can dwell with the devouring fire? who among us can dwell with everlasting burnings?

15.web: He who walks righteously, and speaks blamelessly; He who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of blood, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—
15.asv: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from taking a bribe, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from looking upon evil:

16.web: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.
16.asv: He shall dwell on high; his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks; his bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.

17.web: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.
17.asv: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold a land that reacheth afar.

18.web: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?
18.asv: Thy heart shall muse on the terror: Where is he that counted, where is he that weighed the tribute? where is he that counted the towers?

19.web: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.
19.asv: Thou shalt not see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that thou canst not comprehend, of a strange tongue that thou canst not understand.

20.web: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
20.asv: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tent that shall not be removed, the stakes whereof shall never be plucked up, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.

21.web: But there Yahweh will be with us in majesty, a place of broad rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.
21.asv: But there Jehovah will be with us in majesty, a place of broad rivers and streams, wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

22.web: For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.
22.asv: For Jehovah is our judge, Jehovah is our lawgiver, Jehovah is our king; he will save us.

23.web: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.
23.asv: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not strengthen the foot of their mast, they could not spread the sail: then was the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame took the prey.

24.web: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.
24.asv: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
